prompt_fields.subject: One complete copperhead viper with a distinctly broad copper-colored triangular head, narrow neck and tapering tail. Its body makes a loose open double bend like an offset S, rather than closing into a circle; head low and forward at lower left, tail curving toward upper left.
prompt_fields.contrast: Existing brown snake is a thick round closed coil with central dark hole and near-uniform warm brown body. Copperhead must read as a longer, more open serpentine diagonal with separated head and tail; broad bright copper head and darker deep-russet body create a different large-value pattern. Avoid a rattlesnake rattle or cobra hood.
prompt_fields.composition: One entire animal on one thin disc. Keep head, tail and every bend inside rim; open disc gap between separated body turns. Leave upper-right UI margin free of head. Scale the wedge head large enough to remain apparent at 48px, without exaggerating into a dragon head.
prompt_fields.palette: Copper-orange head, deep reddish-brown body, muted pale tan broad hourglass saddles and underbelly. Matte natural scales with restrained highlights. No fangs as a separate status symbol, poison cloud, liquid or green glow.
